Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates complete opacification ("white-out") of the right hemithorax with a significant shift of the mediastinum and trachea to the contralateral (left) side. This combination of findings, along with the clinical history of dullness on percussion, is characteristic of a massive right pleural effusion exerting mass effect; in contrast, lung collapse would typically cause an ipsilateral mediastinal shift.
